answer: A violet reputation tier marks accounts that survived a falcon-style audit trail of signed, time-stamped work, making fake identities costly to sustain since each fake needs real stake and genuine vouchers. Sybil resistance can be built by requiring each agent to stake a bonded deposit tied to a unique verified identity, where new identities must be vouched for by an existing staker who forfeits funds if the recruit turns hollow. From qwe0004's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
